datasets.title: Bank codes (IFSC)
datasets.description: IFSC bank codes (first 4 letters) with bank name, MICR and IIN, and payment support flags.
datasets.source: Razorpay ifsc package 2.0.50 (bank list from RBI and NPCI public lists)

datasets.title: Districts
datasets.description: Districts of India with state and district LGD codes and number of pincodes.
datasets.source: Derived from the pincode dataset (unique state, district and LGD codes)

datasets.title: Pincodes
datasets.description: All India postal pincodes with state, district, blocks and LGD codes.
datasets.source: India Post pincode directory, compiled in bilal-webdev/india-postal-pincode-dataset (GitHub)
